Bounty.description: Opening requires verified funding/escrow capability and policy; absent settlement support blocks publication instead of simulating payment.

Watermark.description: Clients compare chain position before revision; quarantined responses retain last healthy height.

Candle.description: UTC half-open buckets; week Monday00:00. Missing buckets omitted by default. Optional display carry bars are separate labelled adapter data with zero contribution and cannot enter volume,ranking or canonical storage.

Price.description: Gross execution uses actual paid input/output; post-swap spot uses pinned effective reserves and is not executable liquidation proceeds; external display never gates core launch/trade.

ChainPosition.description: All integer comparisons use numeric ordering, including heights beyond JavaScript safe integer range.

Trade.description: Preserve exact paid versus optical-priced input and input-asset fee disposition. Current qualified Swap paidInput and fee are nonnull; pricedInput nullable only explicitly unavailable receipt/ABI proof; never derive pricedInput by dividing rounded fee bybps.

Message.description: Deleted text hidden in public projection; audit retention restricted; sends require membership and ban checks in same authorized transaction.

Notification.description: Public payload contains entity link and bounded text; no private message body in push/email by default.

Order.description: Supported kinds are capability-gated by verified deployed contract selectors; absent support returns501 instead of synthetic accepted order.

PortfolioUpdate.description: Each change is upsert with typed PortfolioPosition or remove withpositionId+revision. Changes and summary are one committed checkpoint. Larger rebuild sends resnapshot_required rather than partial coherent-state claim.

PortfolioPosition.description: Apply req.D06_001,D06_002,D06_005 proportional_floor_v1 exactly. For total T=K+U and disposal q, k=floor(q*K/T),u=q-k,pK=floor(P*k/q),pU=P-pK,c=floor(C*k/K) when K>0; c=C when k=K. Remaining K-k,U-u,C-c; known realized increases pK-c. Unknown proceeds never imply zero-cost gain. Outgoing transfer invents no sale proceeds. Verified linked-wallet basis carry requires explicit policy/consent.

PortfolioSummary.description: pricedSubtotal sums only known marked positions and is explicitly partial if anyunpriced. completeValue isnull until all valuations known. Summary covers allpositions,not currentpage. Unknown profitability remainsnull; PAX gas never subtracted asUSDL without conversion provenance.

RankingSnapshot.description: Realtime replaces bounded top100view from one immutable ranking snapshot. REST pages same immutable full snapshot; totalEligible/truncated disclose remainder. Every entry model/category equals snapshot. Gainers/losers are signed-return models,not aliases ofmovers.

RankingEntry.description: Canonical decimal score finite with model-versioned precision and feature window; deterministic normalized pool-address tie-break. Sponsored placement separate from organic score.

Reward.description: Claimability derives verified contract state or funded authorized program ledger; display cannot invent balances or settlement.

PoolStats.description: realUsdlBalanceRaw is booked real USDL backing, not virtual reserve or guaranteed per-wallet entitlement. Optional indicative TVL excludes virtual USDL and declares token mark. Rolling window end is source watermark chainSecond+1 with events constrained<=sourceUpperPosition; [end-window,end) event-time membership.

Stream.description: Public shape never includes ingest key; live status comes from authenticated provider evidence; viewer count distinct TTL heartbeats.
